auth.mapping: IAM project view; provider storage account belongs to selected project, not account IAM scope
auth.limitation: authenticated SDK view only; omitted source security is not treated as proof of anonymous availability

endpoint.mapping: published Object Storage regional map; exact ref pins endpoint, no S3/Swift ref conversion

request.mapping: all generated source DTO properties; omitted/null/false/empty/integer precision preserved; protected filter object revealed only at typed request boundary
request.defaults: none invented; log iteration explicitly starts requested offset or zero

response.mapping: all source-defined fields in generated typed DTO; schemaless filters protected, provider timestamps raw; task identity extracted before full decode and checked against exact ref

errors.mapping: shared HTTP classification; source-documented 400/422 input failures override to invalid_argument, explicit 4xx source statuses are rejected proofs; provider messages not exposed

retry: mutations never replay; safe GET retries remain bounded by common runtime
wait: unavailable: no documented log export state enum/readiness predicate; exact Status is presence observation only
recovery: known outcomes conclusive without I/O; unknown without task ID unavailable; known exact task GET remains indeterminate, never replay/list-name adoption

pagination.mapping: limit/uint64 offset/order_by; exact offset advances by wire item count; short page is not end, empty tasks array confirms end for best-effort traversal
pagination.limits: SDK wire cap1000, explicit collection budgets and resumable offset/skip cursor; no snapshot guarantee
pagination.scope: cursor includes project/location/contract revision/filter/initial offset and endpoint URL
